title: Aimium workspace v2
description: Local workspace configuration with separate website associations and explicit agent authority. A null model binding means no connector is configured. Not a profile export or native persistence implementation.

associated_origins.description: Website associations for finding a saved workspace. These grant no agent or workflow authority. The start URL's canonical origin must be present, checked by the reference validator.

allowed_origins.description: Explicit agent authority, independent from website associations. Empty means no origin is authorized.
